Dear City Hub Tokyo Group Bookings Team,

My name is Emma Johnson, and I am writing on behalf of Blue Sparrow Tech. We are interested in booking a group stay at your hotel for 10 people in June.

Could you please provide information on:
- Availability for 10 guests during June 2025
- Room options and rates for a group of this size
- Any group booking policies or requirements
- Cancellation terms for group reservations

Please let me know if you need any additional details from our side.

Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
